g.text: Same hw0 eight-card Ascend 910B2 host · K5 · APC + AIV enabled · cold shape cohorts
ABBA + DP supplement; >=4 valid cohorts except hollow squares: 2 within one startup. Bands: observed cohort range, not confidence intervals.
All eight ranks must match actual work in the same target wave. DP 1024 prompt splits 1018 + 6; mixed 1018 join splits 1012 + 6.
Native acceptance and generated histories may differ. Fixed-query step period is not output token/s; TP and DP are not equal-concurrency comparisons.
